corrections.severity: critical candidate correctness and stated reuse
corrections.detail: Candidate A must designate one producer subgroup or a non-overlapping set of work-items to load/store the pooled 512-byte key row. If all four SG32 consumer subgroups use the same lane-to-row write, they duplicate global loads and concurrently write the same SLM elements. Equal values do not remove the C++ data race.
corrections.action: Clarify single-owner staging, followed by an unconditional barrier for all 128 work-items; only then may the four subgroups consume the shared row.

corrections.detail: The caller permits 1..256 query rows per batch. A 4-query tile can have 1..3 absent slots; those subgroups must not read step/query rows but all work-items must cross the work-group barrier. Share pooled key only if b<n_bid for every populated query; mixed dead/live blocks require per-query key selection or a no-reuse edge path.
corrections.action: Add partial-query-tile and uniform reuse-condition gates; retain per-query dead row, tail bonus, and output bounds.

corrections.detail: Source expression order is correctly described, but it does not pin compiled multiply-add contraction/reassociation. Exact score-bit parity remains a valid gate only with source, compiler flags, target, and baseline binary recorded; inspect codegen when a bit changes.
corrections.action: Keep exact FP32 score and ID parity; state that codegen/flags determine binary arithmetic behavior.

corrections.detail: R731 already proposed four adjacent query subgroups scoring the same block with the pooled key staged in SLM. R1024 adds exact source operation order and mixed dead/live detail, so classify it as a source-specific clarification; do not index the topology as a new candidate.
